name: Tailark

exclusions.name: radix-alternate-implementations
exclusions.reason: The public Tailark installer and isolated view routes resolve the Base catalogue. Radix implementations are retained as upstream alternatives but are not independently published as duplicate assets.

previewStrategy: Official isolated Tailark /view/[name] route for the exact Base registry item.
installationStrategy: Official Tailark /r/[name].json shadcn registry item. Package and registry dependencies were statically parsed from the pinned _registry.ts declarations without executing upstream code.
